source.name: Amica Insurance: Amica and the Boston Celtics
source.quote: The Amica logo appears in Celtics signature team colors on the front left shoulder of Celtics game jerseys.
source.note: Amica's current partnership page. An Amica press release (2026-02-01) confirms Amica 'became the team's official jersey patch sponsor beginning with the 2024–25 season'. The previous source (NBC Sports Boston) blocks automated access.
